# Modèle de sortie – handover

En tête : **direction** = je reçois / je transmets.

## Understanding check
## Context & objective
## Decisions already taken
| Decision | Rationale | Source / date |
## Open points & risks
| Item | Status | Risk if ignored | Owner |
## Key contacts
| Name | Role | For what |
## Reference documents & tickets

## Completeness checklist (✅ couvert / ⚠️ partiel / ❌ absent)
Scope and status · Customer requirements and system requirements · Decisions and rationale ·
Commitments to the customer · Open questions · Known issues · Test status (Xray) · Planning and
milestones · Contacts and escalation · Documentation location

## Missing to be autonomous
Questions (si je reçois) ou informations à ajouter (si je transmets), en anglais, prêtes à envoyer.
